scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.workers.jsonc --env preview
scripts.check:deploy: npm run build:preview && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.workers.jsonc --env preview --dry-run --outdir /tmp/music-recsys-worker-check
